market_definition: Polyurethane Sealants comprises moisture-curing and multi-component polyurethane formulations used to seal joints and interfaces requiring elasticity, adhesion and resistance to movement. It includes packaged sealant products supplied for construction, transport and industrial sealing. By Component System • One-Component • Two-Component By Cure / Chemistry • Moisture-Cure • Chemical-Cure • Low-Modulus • High-Modulus By Form • Cartridge • Sausage • Pail / Bulk By Application • Expansion Joints • Concrete Joints • Automotive Seams • Industrial Enclosures By End Use • Construction • Automotive and Transportation • Marine • General Industry By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Polyurethane adhesives sold for structural bonding; spray polyurethane foam; coatings, foams and other polyurethane products not sold as sealants. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
